units.source_text: 总而言之，下一个对弈日—八月十日的头天晚上，全体人员说服大竹七段同意续弈。

en.t: In short, on the night before the next playing day, August 10, everyone persuaded Otake 7-dan to agree to resume the game.

units.source_text: 人家说东他说西，他身上好像有一股顽劣孩子似的别扭劲，

en.t: If someone said east, he would say west; there seemed to be in him a perverseness like that of a naughty child,

units.source_text: 似是点头同意了，其实又不然，显得非常顽固。

en.t: as if he had nodded and agreed, yet in fact he had not, and he appeared extremely stubborn.

units.source_text: 报社相关记者和棋院工作人员笨嘴笨舌，实在无法对付他。

en.t: The newspaper reporters concerned and the staff of the Go institute were poor at persuasion and simply could not deal with him.

units.source_text: 安永一四段是大竹七段的知心朋友，又善于处理纠纷，他自告奋勇去说服七段。

en.t: Yasunaga Ichi 4-dan was a close friend of Otake 7-dan and was also good at handling disputes, so he volunteered to go and persuade the 7-dan.
